title: Gareon
summary: Gareon is a lizard-like Titan that can stick to walls like a gecko and whose camouflage abilities far surpass those of a chameleon. Due to his ability to become invisible, Gareon is regularly used to cross enemy lines and report back with valuable information. Gareon Amulets are in the possession of a number of Seekers, including Zhalia Moon and Suits of the Organization.

sections.heading: Zhalia's Gareon
sections.text:
Zhalia Moon received Gareon as her first Titan after being adopted by the Organization's scientist, Klaus. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs] Training for years alongside her Titan, they developed a bond much tighter than most Seekers ever have with their Titans. [Huntik.com] Her Gareon even behaved like a pet cat when she was feeling down.

Gareon helped to defeat a Redcap in the Prague Huntik Hotel, when Zhalia came to the rescue of Dante Vale, Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill from some Suits. Gareon was later invoked by Zhalia alongside Kilthane in the attic of Jodis Lore. After turning invisible, Gareon snuck behind Grier and stunned him with his eye beams. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies]

Zhalia invoked Gareon whilst rescuing Peter from a pair of police officers in Paris. Turning invisible, Gareon was able to stun the policemen while Zhalia and Peter made their mistake. Gareon was later invoked to fight in the Cave of the Gargoyle against the Organization forces. [Into the River of Secrets]

Gareon played a vital role in getting the Ring of Arc to Clements at the Cathedral of Notre Dame, using his invisibility to sneak past the Organization forces spread throughout the Paris Catacombs. He was later seen being held by Zhalia at the safehouse following the team's mission. [Divide and Conquer]

In Iceland, Zhalia and Gareon attempted to slow Ymir down by blasting him in the face. [The Legacy of Thor] Gareon was later used in the Temple of Thor to hold back the Guardians of Thor. [Two Powers Become One]

Zhalia used Gareon in the Basilisk House where he surprised Lok and Sophie. His Amulet was later taken by DeFoe and left in a bag when Zhalia, Sophie and Lok were ambushed and taken prisoner. After Zhalia freed herself, Gareon took Defoe's bag and gave it to Lok and Sophie, enabling them to invoke Freelancer and Sabriel against the Organization. [Absent Heroes]

Gareon was used when Zhalia fought against Grier in the hull of the shipwreck, but was defeated by his Dragonfist power. [The Treasures of the Argonauts] On Madea Island, an illusion of Gareon was invoked against Zhalia alongside Kilthane and Strix by an image of a young Zhalia, created by the Titan Madea. Garion attacked Lok's Freelancer but was defeated. [The Beautiful Trap]

Gareon was used to attack one Klaus's men in the Tomb of Nefertiti while the Huntik team tried to escape with the Sceptre of Nefertiti. [The Sceptre Deception] Gareon was later used to attack Sophie in the Castle of Vlad Dracul after Zhalia betrayed the team to Klaus. His attacks were blocked by Sophie's Honorguard. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

Gareon was seen comforting Zhalia in her apartment as she pondered over how she could make up for betraying Dante and his team. [Ladies' Choice]

Gareon was used to attack two of Rassimov's Suits in King Solomon's Mines. After stunning one Suit, he was hit by an Augerfrost before running away. [To Be Together]

Zhalia invoked Gareon to fight against Sophie in The Professor's castle when the two came into conflict over Dante's decision to give the Professor the Rings of Behemoth and Tao. After defeating Icarus, Gareon was sent back to his Amulet by Sabriel. [The Divine Comedy] Gareon later fought alongside Hoplite against two Undergolem Titans summoned by Eathon the dog but both were defeated. [The Mission]

Following the defeat of the Professor, Gareon was used to take out two Suits during the team's attack on Organization Central. Gareon was later used in Peru to defeat a Mindrone summoned by the forces of Wilder.[Doorway to Huntik]

Zhalia summoned Gareon in the Crystal Caves where he fought alongside Dante's Caliban and Lok's Lindorm against White's Palamedes and Mallory's Pellinore. After a fierce battle, Gareon was defeated by Palamedes. [Cave of the Casterwills]

On the island of Medusa, Gareon assisted Zhalia in tracking down Stack and the Blood Spiral Seeker Kiel. Zhalia pondered to Gareon over infiltrating the cave before leaving while Gareon returned to his Amulet. [Zhalia's Mission]

When Zhalia was caught infiltrating the Blood Spiral by Tantras, Gareon Powerbonded with her. Using his Scramblemind ability, the two erased Tantras' memory of her being a double-agent. [Sophie on Trial]

Powerbonded Gareon again was invoked during the confrontation against the Betrayer and Demigorgan when Zhalia rejoined her team. Using his Camouflage ability, Gareon managed to sneak through the battle and land a direct attack to Demigorgan. However, Demigorgan used its abilities to summon a copy of Zhalia to confuse and subvert the Rapport-Bond. The copy of Zhalia then transformed itself into the Titan before it was defeated by Powerbonded Pendragon. Gareon rejoined Zhalia and the others and later assisted Lucas Casterwill and Sandra Lambert in their attack on the Betrayer. However, after dodging multiple attacks, Gareon was defeated by the Betrayer's ability to use the Spiral Mark to revive himself. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S1E06 Gareon invisible Suits flashback.png|thumb|174x174px|Gareon slips through the [[Suits]] unnoticed with its invisibility]]
Gareon's Limited Invisibility ability allows him to camouflage himself as his scales can warp light around him. This ability permits Gareon to infiltrate enemy lines; however, attacking renders this invisibility null. {{source|Huntik.com/Profiles|Huntik.com}} Gareon Titans also can cling to surfaces and move along the walls of building or caves like a gecko. {{source|Words of Truth, Heart of Lies}} Gareon can surround themselves with a magical aura that allows them to float in place. {{source|Two Powers Become One}} Gareon is able to attack with laser blasts from his eyes and mouth. {{source|Huntik.com/Secret Files|Huntik.com}}His teeth and claws can be used for direct combat, as Gareon has a habit of chewing up anything that gets near his mouth. {{source|Huntik.com/Secret_Files|Huntik.com}}

sections.heading: Powerbonding
sections.text:
' memories with Powerbonded Gareon's Scramblemind|199x199px]]
After forming a tight bond with his Seeker, Gareon grew significantly in size and became equipped with armor covering his chest and a reptilian frill around his head. His eyes too changed from yellow to red. [Sophie on Trial] His speed and maneuverability has increased, and his eye blasts are now significantly more powerful. [Dante's Return] His new Powerbonded abilities include:
*Camouflage - renders him invisible, far more potent than his previous Limited Invisibility power. [Dante's Return]
*Scramblemind - allows him and Zhalia to manipulate opponents' minds and erase their short-term memories. [Sophie on Trial]

sections.heading: Design History
sections.wikitext:
Gareon was designed as a small, lizard-like Titan with the camouflage abilities of a chameleon. Originally, he was designed to be more humanoid, but was made more animal-like to add variety to the Titans. He was given spots on his back and arms to mimic the camouflage of real animals. His final design was given sharp teeth and claws for a fierce appearance. {{source|Huntik.com/Secret Files|Huntik.com}}
